summary: One brand filled Button beside secondary actions drawn with tone="neutral": an outlined Button, a small ghost Button and an outlined IconButton.
use: Dense work screens (queues, inboxes, CRMs) with one primary action and several secondary ones that must not compete with it.
spec: `<Button variant="filled">` labelled Send reply is the only brand-coloured control
`<IconButton variant="outlined" tone="neutral" aria-label="More actions">` with a MoreHorizontal icon
